findings.title: Design spec still documents push_pr as `gh pr create --fill`
findings.detail: §7.5 step 4 says: "`pr`: `run push_pr` — the session runs `git push -u origin <branch>` and `gh pr create --base <base> --fill`, then `done --step push_pr --url <pr-url>`". The diff replaces `--fill` with a generated `--title '<title>' --body-file <path>` (internal/finish/pr.go, internal/brief/templates/run-push_pr.md, internal/decide/questions.go's `pr` option text) precisely to stop describing inputs that don't exist, but this master spec — the doc the rubric names as authoritative — was not updated and now self-contradicts the template it is supposed to describe.

findings.title: Claude Code op-table prompt still spells out `gh pr create --fill` for push_pr
findings.detail: The `run` row's push_pr parenthetical reads "...then `git push -u origin <branch>` and `gh pr create --base <base> --fill`", which no longer matches the op's rendered instructions (title/body-file from the run's own artifacts, no `--fill`). This is the live prompt text loaded for the `/takt` command (design spec §6), so it should reflect the new command.

findings.title: Copilot host prompt still spells out `gh pr create --fill` for push_pr
findings.detail: Same stale parenthetical as commands/takt.md line 31 ("`gh pr create --base <base> --fill`"). Design spec §6.1 states this file is meant to carry "the same op table as `commands/takt.md`" — both copies are now stale together and neither documents the new `--title`/`--body-file` command this diff introduces.

findings.title: §4.2's exhaustive bundle-file listing omits the new finish/pr.md artifact
findings.detail: The `### 4.2 Files` tree lists every file a bundle can contain, including `finish/verify.json`, `finish/goals.json` and `finish/retro-inputs.json` (lines 194-197), but the diff adds a new artifact written under the same directory — `finish/pr.md` (internal/finish/pr.go's `PRPath`/`WritePR`, populated by `preparePushPR`) — and the tree was not updated to list it.
